author: Adobe Creative Cloud
description:
Known for their striking title sequences, watch Lexi Gunvladson, Head of Editorial at Imaginary Forces, demoes how they never strike out thanks to Object Mask in Premiere. By masking out their subjects with this tool, they're able to dynamically place the text into the sequences, layering it under their masked object. Object Mask makes this maneavour seamless and makes the results stunning.
